== Biography ==
[[Category: Peoria County, Illinois]] [[Category: Smithville Cemetery, Hanna City, Illinois]]
Daughter of Robert Barclay Glasgow and Rosanna Finley.

She married her first cousin, Nathaniel Cyrus Patton.

In 1848 they moved from Adams County, Ohio to a farm in Peoria County, Illinois.

Nathaniel and Margaret had ten children.
